title: The Bastards of Bollywood Season 2 Confirmed: Aryan Khan's Netflix Hit Gears Up for Return
excerpt: Actor Rajat Bedi and co-writer Bilal Siddiqi confirm the satirical Bollywood drama is in active development, with Netflix and Red Chillies Entertainment in discussions for the sophomore season.
body:
• Actor Rajat Bedi has confirmed that The Bastards of Bollywood Season 2 is in active development, telling News18 that he will return for the new season
  • Co-writer Bilal Siddiqi says conversations between Netflix and Red Chillies Entertainment are ongoing for the sophomore season
  • Season 1, Aryan Khan's directorial debut, premiered on Netflix in September 2025 and received positive reviews for its satirical take on the Hindi film industry
  • The show's star-studded cameo lineup included Shah Rukh Khan, Salman Khan, Aamir Khan, Ranbir Kapoor, and several other Bollywood heavyweights

Aryan Khan's directorial debut appears set for a second chapter. Multiple people involved in The Bastards of Bollywood have confirmed that Season 2 of the Netflix satirical drama is in the works, with conversations between the streaming giant and Shah Rukh Khan's Red Chillies Entertainment actively underway.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=cwMOw5reIRI

Rajat Bedi Breaks the News

Actor Rajat Bedi, who plays the role of forgotten star Jaraj Saxena in the series, was the first to publicly confirm the renewal. In an interview with News18, Bedi was unequivocal about the show's future.

"Yes, season two is happening. It's in the works. I'm hopeful that audiences are going to see more of me in the second season."

— Rajat Bedi, actor

Bedi, whose career experienced a major resurgence thanks to the show, described the impact as transformative. "Suddenly, my life has taken a U-turn. I'm getting so much love from all around the world. It feels like the rains are finally over and the sun is out shining bright," he told the outlet.

Netflix and Red Chillies in Active Talks

Co-writer Bilal Siddiqi offered a more measured update in an interview with Filmfare, confirming that discussions for Season 2 are progressing. "Conversations are going on between Netflix and Red Chillies and whenever they are ready, we'll start that journey," Siddiqi said. He is also currently working on Awarapan 2, a sequel to the 2007 thriller.

The show marks the sixth collaboration between Netflix and Red Chillies Entertainment, following Bard of Blood, Darlings, Bhakshak, Betaal, and Class of '83. Netflix India's Vice-President of Content, Monika Shergill, has previously called the series "a shining addition to our diverse slate."

A Debut That Defied Expectations

Season 1 premiered on September 18, 2025, with seven episodes running between 39 and 56 minutes each. Created, co-written, and directed by Aryan Khan — a USC School of Cinematic Arts graduate — the series offered a self-aware, satirical look at the machinery behind Bollywood's glitz.

The show follows Aasmaan Singh, an ambitious outsider from Delhi whose successful debut under a powerful producer draws him into the chaotic world of industry rivalries, family secrets, and high-stakes power plays. It stars Bobby Deol, Lakshya Lalwani, Raghav Juyal, Sahher Bambba, Anya Singh, Manoj Pahwa, and Mona Singh.

What made the show a cultural talking point, however, was its extraordinary roster of cameos. Shah Rukh Khan, Salman Khan, Aamir Khan, Ranveer Singh, Ranbir Kapoor, Karan Johar, SS Rajamouli, Sara Ali Khan, Ibrahim Ali Khan, and several others made appearances, lending the series a meta quality that delighted audiences.

What's Next for Season 2

Reports from Filmfare and other outlets suggest Season 2 is gearing up for "double the drama and extravaganza" compared to the first season, with pre-production expected to begin soon. While no official release date has been announced, industry estimates point to a potential late 2026 or 2027 premiere if production moves forward on schedule.

"With The Bastards of Bollywood, I wanted to build a world that feels alive, a mix of glitz and grit, where ambition shines, egos clash, and nothing is ever as it seems."

— Aryan Khan, creator and director

Produced by Gauri Khan, the series has been widely praised for balancing sharp industry commentary with genuine entertainment. For Aryan Khan, the show's success has established him as a storytelling voice in his own right — separate from his father's towering legacy, even as that legacy provided some of the show's most memorable moments on screen.
nri_angle: Aryan Khan's directorial debut showcases the next generation of the Indian film industry's most prominent family, with SRK's Red Chillies Entertainment continuing to shape global entertainment content through Netflix.
